DraftKings is offering a King of the End Zone promotion for Monday’s game, with the winners being rewarded with a massive $2 million in bonus bets. If you opt in to the token and place a singles bet of at least $5 on a player in a touchdown market and he scores the longest touchdown of the night, you win a share of the $2 million in bonus bets. Below we will track all the touchdowns from tonight’s game and determine a winner.

George Kittle is the King of the End Zone

George Kittle’s 11-yard TD was the longest of the night, which means he will be crowned tonight’s King of the End Zone. Congrats to all George Kittle bettors.
